text: The thesis that mental properties supervene on physical properties implies that there can be no mental difference without a physical difference.
explanation: Supervenience just is the claim that any two things (or worlds) identical in all physical respects must be identical in all mental respects — i.e. no mental difference without some physical difference. It is weaker than reduction, since it can hold even where type-type mental-physical identities fail, which is why non-reductive physicalists embrace it. The statement is therefore true.
